title: Zoni's Mob Ores
description: Let's you mine and craft mob drops!
body:
[![alt text](https://www.bisecthosting.com/partners/custom-banners/aa8962f9-e6ff-4a83-8eeb-d145d3c55343.webp) ](https://bisecthosting.com/Zoni25)

With this mod you will be able to find ores all around your world and when you mine them you will get Mob Essence. This new item can be used to craft almost any kind of Vanilla mob drop!

For now only agressive mobs are supported because i imagined this mod to be used in Peaceful Difficulty, but I might add passive mobs as well in the future.

The position of the items in the Crafting Table matters for what drop you get so its better to use a recipe mod like JEI.

Have fun!

 

If you want to get updates on the mod development, report bugs or sugest new stuff or just contact me join my discord server:
